resources.string: Tap the time to hear it. Tap twice to hear the date.
Shows while Niko Clock is listening for a shake.
Shake the phone to hear the time
Niko Clock is listening for a shake. To stop, turn off Shake to hear the time in Niko Clock settings.
Shows for a moment while Niko Clock says the time.
A big clock. Tap it to hear the time.
Clock. Tap to hear the time.
The phone gives a short buzz just before it speaks, so the person is ready to listen. Helpful for people who are hard of hearing.
Niko Clock says the time by itself at set times through the day, even when the phone is locked. Pressing the button or shaking the phone always works too.
No regular announcements during these hours, so nobody is woken at night. Tapping the time, the button or shaking the phone still works.
When the phone is on Do Not Disturb, regular announcements stay quiet. Asking for the time still works.

Shake the phone quickly a few times to hear the time, even with the screen off and locked. Shake again right after to hear the date. Walking or putting the phone down won\'t set it off. It uses a little more battery.
Some phones close apps in the background to save battery. That can stop announcements and shake. Set Niko Clock to No restrictions or Unrestricted.
A 4-number PIN stops settings being changed by accident. The clock itself always works without it.
Report a problem or ask a question
Send it to family and friends
Niko Clock says the time out loud. Free, no ads, works without internet: %1$s
Niko Clock has no internet access. It doesn\'t collect, store or send anything about you. Settings stay on this phone.
After the time is spoken, shake again within a few seconds to hear today\'s date.
Niko Clock may stop speaking by itself. A helper can fix this in settings.
Needed to say the time on the minute
When Niko Clock last said the time by itself. If this is much older than it should be, the phone may be stopping Niko Clock. Check the phone settings below.
Go through the main settings again
Today\'s date. Tap it to hear the date.
The time and date. Tap either one to hear it.
Date. Tap to hear the date.
Shows the day, the part of day and the date in large words

For people who lose track of the day. The main screen shows the day of the week, whether it is morning, afternoon, evening or night, and the full date. While the phone is charging, the screen stays on. At night it turns dark.
Adds the Bikram Sambat date, such as 1 Kartik 2083, under the date on the clock. When the voice speaks English or Nepali, it also says it after the date.
A short line for the person, such as \"Ram visits today\". It shows on the clock and is read out after the date. Change or remove it when it\'s out of date.

Each morning at the chosen time, Niko Clock says good morning and the date, with the Nepali date and the note if they are on. It speaks during quiet hours, but stays quiet during Do Not Disturb if chimes do.
Show on the lock screen while charging
While the phone is charging, the day clock stays in front of the lock screen, so it can be read without unlocking. Opening settings still needs the phone to be unlocked.
